description: Implementation of the IMediaDeathNotifier interface, managing media service death notifications and callbacks within Android's media framework.

classes.name: IMediaDeathNotifier
classes.description: Interface for media death notification handling.

classes.name: IMediaDeathNotifier::DeathNotifier
classes.description: Inner class handling binder death callbacks.

methods.name: IMediaDeathNotifier::getMediaPlayerService
methods.description: Establishes and returns the binder interface to the MediaPlayerService.

methods.name: IMediaDeathNotifier::addObitRecipient
methods.description: Adds a recipient to be notified upon media service death.

methods.name: IMediaDeathNotifier::removeObitRecipient
methods.description: Removes a recipient from death notifications.

methods.name: IMediaDeathNotifier::DeathNotifier::binderDied
methods.description: Callback invoked when the media server dies, notifying all registered recipients.

methods.name: IMediaDeathNotifier::DeathNotifier::~DeathNotifier
methods.description: Destructor that clears recipients and unlinks death notification.
